- Descriptive; not prespecified in the SAP.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Follow-up from consent

```{r}
#| label: accepted-patients

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)
all_discussions <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-mtb-discussions.parquet")
) |>
  left_join(select(cohort, id, tx), by = "id") |>
  mutate(group = group_factor(tx))

accepted <- cohort |>
  filter(invitation_accepted == 1L) |>
  left_join(
    all_discussions |> filter(status == "discussed") |> count(id, name = "n_discussed"),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_discussed = if_else(is.na(n_mtb), NA_integer_, coalesce(n_discussed, 0L)),
    # Missing vital status gives a missing endpoint date, not a censored one.
    endpoint_date = if_else(
      status_death_unrestricted == 1L,
      death_date,
      last_known_alive_date
    ),
    # enrolled_date is the consent date in the export.
    follow_up_days_from_consent = as.numeric(
      endpoint_date - as.Date(enrolled_date)
    ),
    has_eight_weeks = !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent) &
      follow_up_days_from_consent >= 56
  )

if (nrow(accepted) == 0L) stop("No patients accepted the invitation.")

# Accepters with known follow-up shorter than eight weeks, and with none.
short_follow_up <- accepted |>
  filter(!has_eight_weeks, !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent))

died_before_eight_weeks <- sum(short_follow_up$status_death_unrestricted == 1L)
censored_before_eight_weeks <- sum(
  short_follow_up$status_death_unrestricted == 0L
)
follow_up_date_missing <- sum(is.na(accepted$follow_up_days_from_consent))
```

## MTB outcomes

```{r}
#| label: mtb-outcomes

mtb_summary <- bind_rows(
  "All invitation accepters" = accepted,
  "At least 8 weeks from consent" = filter(accepted, has_eight_weeks),
  .id = "population"
) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    registered = sum(mtb_reg == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    registered_percent = 100 * registered / patients,
    discussed = sum(n_discussed >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    discussed_percent = 100 * discussed / patients,
    recommendation_report_sent = sum(mtb_n_reports >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    recommendation_report_sent_percent =
      100 * recommendation_report_sent / patients,
    missing_registration = sum(is.na(mtb_reg)),
    missing_discussion = sum(is.na(n_mtb)),
    missing_recommendation_report = sum(is.na(mtb_n_reports)),
    .by = population
  ) |>
  mutate(
    died_before_eight_weeks = died_before_eight_weeks,
    censored_before_eight_weeks = censored_before_eight_weeks,
    follow_up_date_missing = follow_up_date_missing
  )

distribution <- accepted |>
  count(n_mtb = n_discussed, name = "patients")

write_parquet(
  mtb_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "mtb-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  distribution,
  file.path(results_dir, "mtb-discussion-distribution.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: mtb-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Molecular tumour board outcomes"
#| echo: false

mtb_summary |>
  select(
    population,
    patients,
    registered,
    registered_percent,
    discussed,
    discussed_percent,
    recommendation_report_sent,
    recommendation_report_sent_percent,
    missing_registration,
    missing_discussion,
    missing_recommendation_report
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## MTB discussions

- Content summaries: discussions with status "discussed" on or after randomization; postponed and cancelled
  ones count only in the volume summary.
- Sample of a discussion: the latest valid ctDNA sample on or before the discussion date (both dates are
  shifted by the same participant offset).
- First discussion: the first held discussion on or after randomization; all later ones are subsequent.
- Clinical situation collapsed into progression (progression under therapy or watch-and-wait, relapse),
  response (complete, partial or spontaneous remission), stable (stable or persistent disease), new
  diagnosis and unclear.

```{r}
#| label: mtb-discussions

appraisal_flags <- c(
  "ctdna_first_determination", "ctdna_rising", "ctdna_stable",
  "ctdna_declining", "ctdna_not_detectable", "ctdna_new_alterations",
  "ctdna_unclear"
)
recommended <- c("yes", "yes_with_reservations")

discussed <- all_discussions |>
  filter(status == "discussed", day >= 0) |>
  arrange(id, day, discussion_number) |>
  mutate(
    order = row_number(),
    situation_group = case_when(
      clinical_situation %in% c(
        "progression_under_therapy", "progression_under_watch_and_wait", "relapse"
      ) ~ "progression",
      clinical_situation %in% c(
        "complete_remission", "partial_remission", "spontaneous_remission"
      ) ~ "response",
      clinical_situation %in% c("stable_disease", "persistent_disease") ~ "stable",
      clinical_situation %in% c("new_diagnosis", "unclear") ~ clinical_situation
    ),
    .by = id
  )

stopifnot(
  "Every clinical situation needs a group." =
    !any(is.na(discussed$situation_group) & !is.na(discussed$clinical_situation))
)

with_results <- discussed |>
  filter(ctdna_results_available %in% 1L) |>
  mutate(
    n_appraisals = rowSums(pick(all_of(appraisal_flags))),
    appraisal_combination = pick(all_of(appraisal_flags)) |>
      as.matrix() |>
      apply(1, \(ticked) str_flatten(appraisal_flags[ticked == 1L], " + ")) |>
      na_if("")
  )
```

### Volume and timing

```{r}
#| label: mtb-volume

group_sizes <- cohort |>
  mutate(group = group_factor(tx)) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    accepted = sum(invitation_accepted %in% 1L),
    .by = group
  )

volume <- all_discussions |>
  summarise(
    participants_with_record = n_distinct(id),
    records = n(),
    discussed_any_time = sum(status == "discussed"),
    postponed = sum(status == "postponed"),
    cancelled = sum(status == "cancelled"),
    before_randomization = sum(before_randomization == 1L),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  left_join(
    discussed |>
      summarise(
        participants_discussed = n_distinct(id),
        discussions = n(),
        report_sent = sum(report_sent == 1L),
        first_day_median = median(day[order == 1]),
        first_day_q1 = quantile(day[order == 1], 0.25),
        first_day_q3 = quantile(day[order == 1], 0.75),
        first_day_min = min(day[order == 1]),
        first_day_max = max(day[order == 1]),
        day_median = median(day),
        day_q1 = quantile(day, 0.25),
        day_q3 = quantile(day, 0.75),
        day_max = max(day),
        .by = group
      ),
    by = "group"
  ) |>
  right_join(group_sizes, by = "group") |>
  arrange(group)

discussions_per_participant <- discussed |>
  count(group, id, name = "discussions") |>
  count(group, discussions, name = "participants")

valid_samples <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"),
  col_select = c("id", "sample_date", "baseline", "valid_ctdna_result")
) |>
  filter(valid_ctdna_result)

sample_delays <- with_results |>
  select(discussion_id, id, group, mtb_date) |>
  inner_join(valid_samples, by = "id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(sample_date <= mtb_date) |>
  slice_max(sample_date, by = discussion_id, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(days = as.numeric(mtb_date - sample_date))

sample_delay <- sample_delays |>
  summarise(
    discussions_with_sample = n(),
    median_days = median(days),
    q1_days = quantile(days, 0.25),
    q3_days = quantile(days, 0.75),
    p10_days = quantile(days, 0.1),
    p90_days = quantile(days, 0.9),
    min_days = min(days),
    max_days = max(days),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  left_join(count(with_results, group, name = "discussions_with_results"), by = "group")

timing_plot <- discussed |>
  mutate(
    order = factor(
      pmin(order, 3),
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c("First discussion", "Second discussion", "Third or later discussion")
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(day / 7, fill = group)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 4, boundary = 0, colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(vars(order), ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_group(name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 156, 12)) +
  labs(x = "Weeks from randomization", y = "Discussions")

save_figure(timing_plot, file.path(results_dir, "mtb-discussion-timing.png"), height = 6)
timing_plot
```

### Valid ctDNA samples and discussion

- Invitation accepters; valid samples over the whole follow-up (3 or more pooled).

```{r}
#| label: mtb-samples

first_discussions <- discussed |>
  filter(order == 1) |>
  select(id, mtb_date)

samples_by_discussion <- accepted |>
  select(id, status_death_unrestricted) |>
  left_join(count(valid_samples, id, name = "valid_samples"), by = "id") |>
  left_join(first_discussions, by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    valid_samples = pmin(coalesce(valid_samples, 0L), 3L),
    discussed = !is.na(mtb_date),
    died = status_death_unrestricted %in% 1L
  ) |>
  count(valid_samples, discussed, died, name = "patients")

samples_before_first <- valid_samples |>
  inner_join(filter(first_discussions, id %in% accepted$id), by = "id") |>
  filter(sample_date <= mtb_date) |>
  summarise(
    valid_samples = pmin(n(), 3L),
    latest_baseline = baseline[which.max(sample_date)] == 1L,
    .by = id
  ) |>
  count(valid_samples, latest_baseline, name = "patients")

stopifnot(
  "Every first discussion of an accepter needs a valid sample before it." =
    sum(samples_before_first$patients) ==
      sum(filter(samples_by_discussion, discussed)$patients)
)
```

### Discussion content

```{r}
#| label: mtb-content

# Discussions per level of each variable and group; NA is kept as its own level.
count_levels <- function(data, variables, population) {
  data |>
    select(group, all_of(variables)) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(variables), as.character)) |>
    pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "variable", values_to = "level") |>
    count(group, variable, level) |>
    mutate(population = population, denominator = sum(n), .by = c(group, variable))
}

categories <- bind_rows(
  count_levels(
    discussed,
    c(
      "report_sent", "relevant_marker", "ctdna_results_available",
      "clinical_situation", "situation_group", "targeted_therapy_recommended",
      "escat_tier", "cellular_therapy_recommended", "trial_recommended",
      "n_recommended_drugs",
      str_subset(names(discussed), "^(diag|step)_"),
      "n_oncologists", "n_molecular_pathologists", "n_pathologists", "n_geneticists"
    ),
    "discussed"
  ),
  count_levels(
    with_results,
    c("ctdna_timing", appraisal_flags, "n_appraisals", "appraisal_combination"),
    "ctdna_results"
  ),
  count_levels(
    filter(with_results, order == 1),
    c("ctdna_timing", appraisal_flags),
    "ctdna_results_first"
  ),
  count_levels(
    filter(with_results, order > 1),
    c("ctdna_timing", appraisal_flags),
    "ctdna_results_subsequent"
  ),
  count_levels(
    filter(discussed, targeted_therapy_recommended %in% recommended),
    c("strategy_context", "recommended_line", "escat_tier"),
    "targeted_therapy"
  ),
  count_levels(
    filter(discussed, diag_liquid_biopsy == 1L),
    c("next_ctdna_weeks", "next_ctdna_in_liqplat"),
    "liquid_biopsy"
  )
)

next_ctdna_weeks <- discussed |>
  filter(diag_liquid_biopsy == 1L) |>
  summarise(
    scheduled = n(),
    weeks_recorded = sum(!is.na(next_ctdna_weeks)),
    median_weeks = median(next_ctdna_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_weeks = quantile(next_ctdna_weeks, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_weeks = quantile(next_ctdna_weeks, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_weeks = min(next_ctdna_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_weeks = max(next_ctdna_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = group
  )

participant_ever <- discussed |>
  summarise(
    ctdna_rising = any(ctdna_rising %in% 1L),
    targeted_therapy = any(targeted_therapy_recommended %in% recommended),
    liquid_biopsy = any(diag_liquid_biopsy == 1L),
    report_sent = any(report_sent == 1L),
    .by = c(group, id)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(group, id), names_to = "item", values_to = "ever") |>
  summarise(participants = sum(ever), denominator = n(), .by = c(group, item))
```

### ctDNA appraisal and clinical situation

```{r}
#| label: mtb-appraisal-situation

appraisal_by_situation <- with_results |>
  select(group, situation_group, all_of(appraisal_flags)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(appraisal_flags), names_to = "appraisal", values_to = "ticked") |>
  filter(ticked == 1L) |>
  count(group, appraisal, situation_group) |>
  bind_rows(
    count(with_results, group, situation_group) |> mutate(appraisal = "discussions")
  )
```

### Rising ctDNA

```{r}
#| label: mtb-rising

rising <- with_results |>
  mutate(rising = if_else(ctdna_rising == 1L, "rising", "not_rising")) |>
  summarise(
    discussions = n(),
    targeted_therapy = sum(targeted_therapy_recommended %in% recommended),
    change_of_strategy = sum(strategy_context %in% "change_of_strategy"),
    new_strategy = sum(strategy_context %in% "new_strategy"),
    liquid_biopsy = sum(diag_liquid_biopsy == 1L),
    weeks_recorded = sum(!is.na(next_ctdna_weeks)),
    median_weeks = median(next_ctdna_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_weeks = quantile(next_ctdna_weeks, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_weeks = quantile(next_ctdna_weeks, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(group, rising)
  )
```

### Recommended drugs

```{r}
#| label: mtb-atc

recommended_drugs <- discussed |>
  select(group, id, discussion_id, starts_with("recommended_atc_")) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("recommended_atc_"), values_to = "atc", values_drop_na = TRUE)

atc_subgroups <- tribble(
  ~subgroup, ~subgroup_name,
  "L01EA", "BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EB", "EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EC", "BRAF inhibitors",
  "L01ED", "ALK inhibitors",
  "L01EE", "MEK inhibitors",
  "L01EF", "CDK inhibitors",
  "L01EG", "mTOR kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EH", "HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EJ", "JAK inhibitors",
  "L01EK", "VEGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EL", "BTK inhibitors",
  "L01EM", "PI3K inhibitors",
  "L01EN", "FGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors",
  "L01EX", "Other protein kinase inhibitors",
  "L01FD", "HER2 antibodies",
  "L01FE", "EGFR antibodies",
  "L01FF", "PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors",
  "L01XK", "PARP inhibitors",
  "L01XX", "Other antineoplastic agents"
)

atc_summary <- recommended_drugs |>
  mutate(subgroup = str_sub(atc, 1, 5)) |>
  left_join(atc_subgroups, by = "subgroup") |>
  summarise(
    drugs = n(),
    discussions = n_distinct(discussion_id),
    participants = n_distinct(id),
    .by = c(group, subgroup, subgroup_name)
  ) |>
  arrange(group, desc(drugs), subgroup)

stopifnot(
  "Recommended drugs must be 7-character ATC codes." =
    all(str_detect(recommended_drugs$atc, "^[A-Z][0-9]{2}[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}$")),
  "Every ATC subgroup needs a name." = !anyNA(atc_summary$subgroup_name)
)
```

### Attendance

- Pre-filled defaults: three oncologists and one molecular pathologist.

```{r}
#| label: mtb-attendance

attendance <- discussed |>
  select(group, n_oncologists, n_molecular_pathologists, n_pathologists, n_geneticists) |>
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "specialty", values_to = "attendees") |>
  summarise(
    discussions = n(),
    documented = sum(!is.na(attendees)),
    at_least_one = sum(attendees >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(attendees, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(attendees, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(attendees, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(attendees, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(attendees, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(group, specialty)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: mtb-discussion-write

list(
  "mtb-volume" = volume,
  "mtb-discussions-per-participant" = discussions_per_participant,
  "mtb-sample-delay" = sample_delay,
  "mtb-categories" = categories,
  "mtb-next-ctdna-weeks" = next_ctdna_weeks,
  "mtb-samples-by-discussion" = samples_by_discussion,
  "mtb-samples-before-first" = samples_before_first,
  "mtb-participant-ever" = participant_ever,
  "mtb-appraisal-by-situation" = appraisal_by_situation,
  "mtb-rising" = rising,
  "mtb-atc" = atc_summary,
  "mtb-attendance" = attendance
) |>
  iwalk(\(data, name) {
    write_parquet(
      mutate(data, across(where(is.factor), as.character)),
      file.path(results_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet")),
      compression = "zstd"
    )
  })
```
